subject: Re: HelioTech pilot — platform fee timing & staged SLA/ops waiver
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@heliotech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: operations@heliotech.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform fee timing + pilot support ask

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Two quick asks from procurement and ops as we scope a 3-month pilot across two US sites:

1) Can Redwood defer the platform fee for the pilot period (we'd prefer to pay only committed node usage for the first 90 days) — if so, what conditions apply?
2) Ops asked whether an implementation/observability credit is possible to cover part of the SRE onboarding work (approx 40 hours).
3) Finally, we need a staged SLA approach tied to rollout milestones (pilot, pilot+1 site, full rollout) — would Redwood accept a milestone-based SLA uplift vs. an immediate full production SLA?

Attached is our pilot requirements doc — happy to jump on a call to review. We have budget approvals pending if we can align commercially this week.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
HelioTech

[Attachment: HelioTech_Pilot_REQ_2026.pdf]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@heliotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform fee timing + pilot support ask

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks and the requirements doc — looks straightforward. Quick answers up front:

- Platform fee deferral: yes, we can propose a pilot deferral where the platform fee is waived for the first 90 days in exchange for a committed node/minimum-usage floor for that period. The deferral would convert to the standard platform fee at conversion or at the end of 90 days, whichever comes first.

- Implementation/observability credit: we can offer a one-time technical onboarding credit equivalent to 30 hours of professional services, plus an additional SRE office-hours bundle if you need the 40 hours.

- Staged SLA: we typically do milestone-based SLA uplift offers. Suggested structure: baseline SLA during pilot (98.5%), upgraded SLA (99.5%) after pilot+1 site, and full SLA (99.9%) after full rollout and final handoff. We can tie credits or service credits to missed milestone dates.

Marissa — copying you for pricing specifics and to draft the pilot commercial. Naomi — can you pull the closest comparable pilot we did (customer X last quarter) so we can match credits and guardrails?

I can hop on a call this afternoon if you'd like to finalize terms.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Inline: Logan's vCard]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform fee timing + pilot support ask

Folks —

Draft commercial position below (for Logan -> Elena):

Proposal highlights:
- Pilot term: 90 days.
- Billing during pilot: metered node usage at agreed rates (see attached workbook: redwood_cost_v1.xlsx). Platform fee waived during pilot.
- Minimum commitment: equivalent to 2 nodes / 8 vGPU-days per week (floor to avoid cold-start capacity risk).
- Onboarding credit: 30-hour PS credit + optional 10-hour SRE office-hours add-on at a discounted rate if used within 60 days of pilot start.
- SLA cadence: Pilot SLA 98.5% (no SLA credits except for critical incidents), Post-pilot milestone uplift to 99.5% for pilot+1 site (with small SLA credit pool: 5% of monthly platform fee for each missed milestone up to two occurrences), Full rollout SLA 99.9% with standard credits.
- Ops surcharge waiver: Helio requested a one-time waiver for the on-prem ops surcharge (airgap/extra support). We can grant a partial waiver (50% of first-month ops surcharge) if Helio signs within 10 business days and provides a mutually agreed runbook.

Risks / guardrails to flag to the customer:
- Waiving platform fee during pilot increases capacity risk — require minimum commitment and access to basic telemetry for early issue detection.
- If pilot extends beyond 90 days without conversion, platform fee converts retroactively for month 4 unless parties agree otherwise.

Elena/Helio — if this looks acceptable I can produce a commercial memo and redline a short SOW.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Deals
Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: redwood_cost_v1.xlsx]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@heliotech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: operations@heliotech.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform fee timing + pilot support ask

Logan / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. This commercial position is close to what Procurement/Engineering were hoping for. Two small asks before we proceed:

1) Can the minimum commitment be phrased as a soft floor (we'll aim for 2 nodes but allow +/- 1 node week-to-week during pilot if utilization is low)?
2) For the ops surcharge waiver: instead of a 50% first-month waiver, would Redwood accept a 30% waiver plus the 10-hour discounted SRE add-on at no charge? That keeps our budget neutral and still incentives quick signing.

If you accept those tweaks we have internal approval to sign the SOW and complete payment. Please send the SOW/DocuSign and we'll route it through Legal/Procurement.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
HelioTech
